# auto-job-hunt-skill

> An AI job application agent packaged as a Claude Code skill and plugin (`job-hunt`). It onboards a job seeker with a short interview, compiles a verified fact profile, sources matching roles, writes one tailored ATS-friendly CV per posting, applies through each employer's official channel (ATS forms, email, LinkedIn Easy Apply), and records every role in two CSV ledgers. It never invents facts, never solves CAPTCHAs, and never guesses salary or legal status.

## Start here

- [SKILL.md](skills/job-hunt/SKILL.md): the complete operating directive an agent follows
- [README.md](README.md): install as a plugin or clone, first run, workspace layout, FAQ

## Reference

- [Onboarding](skills/job-hunt/reference/onboarding.md): grill-style first-run interview, per person
- [Profile compilation](skills/job-hunt/reference/profile.md): turning raw CVs and notes into verified facts
- [CV doctrine](skills/job-hunt/reference/cv-doctrine.md): the per-posting CV algorithm, ATS and credibility rules
- [Sourcing](skills/job-hunt/reference/sourcing.md): where roles come from, dedupe, knockout filters
- [Sending](skills/job-hunt/reference/sending.md): ATS form mechanics, email, Gmail, walls and the park pattern
- [LinkedIn Easy Apply](skills/job-hunt/reference/linkedin-easy-apply.md): the optional browser module
- [Verification](skills/job-hunt/reference/verification.md): what counts as proof of a send

## Scripts (Python 3.8+, standard library only)

- `onboard.py`: first-run detection, workspace, per-person scaffold
- `ledger.py`: the only writer of applications.csv and deferred.csv
- `render.py`: HTML CV to one-page PDF via an installed Chrome, Chromium, or Edge
- `preflight.py`: voice, fingerprint, and banned-term gate for every outward document
- `mailbox.py`: automatic email sending with a Gmail app password (optional)
- `linkedin_easy_apply.py`: bounded LinkedIn Easy Apply controller (optional)
- `migrate.py`: convert a v1 layout to the v2 workspace
